title: Biduality of the explicit common-stage dual
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D with algebraically closed field k of characteristic p, a prime l different from p, an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l in an independent universe, and a separated, quasi-compact, locally finite-type k-scheme X. Use the actual rational finite stages C_E, their scalar extensions T_h, and the literal common-stage pair category P of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Let F be Finite data and let hF be FiniteCoherent as defined in [def-sf-common-stage-verdier-data]; thus d_E=(F.datum E).dual has the rational Verdier structures and normalized beta comparisons of [def-sf-rational-verdier-data]. Let V=descendedDual F hF and r_E=descendedComparison F hF E be the fixed constructions of [lem-coef-qbar-verdier-representative-functor]. There exists a natural isomorphism δ:id_P ≅ V.rightOp ⋙ V. For every finite stage E it satisfies SfClassEvaluationCompatible for the inclusion j_E, d_E, V, the specified finite biduality, δ, and r_E. In particular its component at (E,K) is the included finite biduality transported twice through r_E.

proof.text: For a representative f at a common field, expand the two dual maps. Apply the finite scalar biduality square at its source and target: these cancel the outer beta factors against the dual beta maps. Finite biduality naturality then gives δ_K followed by the double dual of f equals f followed by δ_M. Include the finite biduality isomorphism at each literal pair, yielding an isomorphism component without any existence choice.

Use the representative map formula and the identity-component finite comparisons to identify this natural isomorphism with the required SfClassEvaluationCompatible expression. Equality transport from the literal stage system to the published one changes none of these identities.

lean.statement:
theorem descended_biduality (F : Finite D l hl Ω X)
    (hF : FiniteCoherent D l hl Ω X F) :
    ∃ δ : 𝟭 (generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω X) ≅
        (descendedDual D l hl Ω X F hF).rightOp ⋙ descendedDual D l hl Ω X F hF,
      ∀ E : Index l Ω,
        SfClassEvaluationCompatible (inclusion (Y := X) E) (F.datum E).dual
          (descendedDual D l hl Ω X F hF) (F.datum E).bidual.hom δ.hom
          (descendedComparison D l hl Ω X F hF E)
